description: Native search-aware objective preflight on the unified target corpus. This is not a promotion candidate; it tests whether MPE/WDL broad supervision plus policy/ranking targets can move exported representation without another scalar-only loop.

metadata.hypothesis: Scalar-only native Bullet training and local search-aware patching are rejected. The next useful test is the mixed objective itself: use the unified 1409-target legal-move corpus, full quantized forward, MPE/WDL broad supervision from labeled rows, and policy/ranking loss on child positions. The run starts from the best available Enyo-owned native checkpoint only to test whether the objective can improve target move-choice while keeping broad behavior measurable.
metadata.baseline_model_gate: Current native checkpoint on unified targets: top1 337/1409, top3 594/1409, median gap 53.5cp, worst 800cp.
metadata.baseline_reference_gate: Current reference engine at 300k nodes on unified targets: top1 761/1409, top3 1130/1409; mate_like top1 108/235, non_mate top1 653/1174.
required_followup: validate_search_targets_model must beat the baseline target top1 materially
run quantization scan against the init net
run net-diff against the init net
run the unified 300k engine gate only if exported movement is sane

validation.preflight_only: Do not run SPRT from this config.
validation.model_baseline: The init net is top1 337/1409 on the unified target model gate.
validation.continue_only_if: Model gate top1 is at least 600/1409, exported input/L1 movement is present but not explosive, and broad engine gate does not create mate-like tails.
validation.hard_stop: If this only fits the PyTorch target gate but fails exported net-diff/quant-scan or engine search, stop this objective family.
